segments.name: Commercial Banking
segments.description: Serves individuals and companies, excluding global corporate customers, with banking and financial products and services.
segments.evidence: The revenue generated from this segment is derived from the banking and financial products and services offered to both account holders and non-account holders.

segments.name: Global Wholesale Banking
segments.description: Provides national and international tailor-made financial services and structured solutions for global corporate customers.
segments.evidence: Global Wholesale Banking: offers a wide range of national and international tailor-made financial services and structured solutions for our global corporate customers, which are primarily local and multinational corporations.

revenueModel.text: Account holders and non-account holders pay for banking and financial products and services; global corporate customers pay for tailor-made financial and structured solutions.
revenueModel.evidence: The revenue generated from this segment is derived from the banking and financial products and services offered to both account holders and non-account holders.
